```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(timeDate)
library(caret)
```

```{r}
trips_per_day = read_tsv('trips_per_day_2015.tsv')
weather_2015 <- read_csv('weather_2015.csv')

weather_2015 <- weather_2015 %>% 
    rename(ymd = DATE) %>% 
    mutate(ymd = ymd(ymd))

trips <- trips_per_day %>% 
    left_join(weather_2015, by='ymd') %>% 
    rename_with(tolower)

us_holidays <- as.Date(holidayNYSE(year= 2014:2026))

trips <- trips %>% 
    mutate(tmax = tmax * 0.1) %>% 
    mutate(
        tavg = (tmin + tmax) / 2,
        heavy_rain = prcp > 0.9, 
        deep_snow = snwd > 4,
        snow_event = snow > 0,
        day_of_week = wday(ymd, label = TRUE),
        is_weekend = wday(ymd) %in% c(1,7), 
        is_holiday = ymd %in% us_holidays
    ) %>% 
    filter(grepl('^2015-', ymd))

```

```{r}
load('Citibike_Prediction_Model.RData')

predictions <- predict(mod5, newdata = trips)
actual_values <- trips$num_trips
rmse <- RMSE(predictions, actual_values)
rmse

r_squared <- R2(predictions, actual_values)
r_squared

mse <- function(y, y_hat) {
    RMSE(y_hat, y)^2
}

r.squared <- function(y, y_hat) {
    y.bar = mean(y)
    1 - (mse(y, y_hat)/(mean((y.bar - y)^2)))
}

r.squared(actual_values, predictions)
```
